Just relax and spin the wheel to see if it's your lucky day.|[[Changli]]}} '''Hsin's Fortuity''' is an event-exclusive [[Point of Interest|point of interest]] located in [[Taoyuan Vale]], [[Central Plains]], [[Huanglong]] during the [[By Moon's Grace]] event. Players can visit every day during the event for prizes. ==NPCs== * [[Xianchen]] ==Descriptions== {{Description|A recreational stall inspired by the Sentinel Hsin. Rumors say a surprise reward is offered at this stall.
{{Color|#a5a19d|Build or Upgrade this stall to significantly boost Popularity. Visit the stall to experience the mini-games for rewards.}}|[[Map]] description}} Hsin's Fortuity Location.png|Location ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(First interaction) :'''Xianchen:''' Hello, Rover. Have you ever heard the tale of the Fox and the Wheel? :{{DIcon}} Doesn't ring a bell to me. :{{DIcon}} The Fox? :'''Xianchen:''' The Fox is one of the Sentinels in Huanglong. People often call it "Hsin." :'''Xianchen:''' Like our Sentinel "Jue," Hsin has its own state to protect. :'''Xianchen:''' But Hsin loves to join in the celebrations with its people. :'''Xianchen:''' It's said that if you hear the leaves rustling, it must be Hsin wandering in the woods. Sometimes, it even leaves behind small, whimsical gifts, like this lottery wheel here. :'''Xianchen:''' People consider this a good omen, as the sound of the spinning wheel mimics the rustling leaves in the tale. :{{DIcon}} So that's the story... :{{DIcon}} Well, sounds a bit exaggerated. :'''Xianchen:''' True or not, people love blessings. It doesn't matter if it makes sense, it's part of the local culture's charm. :'''Xianchen:''' You have to admit, spinning a lottery wheel is always a thrill. ---- :'''Xianchen:''' Come and spin for good luck here! Win amazing prizes on this special day! Don't miss out! :{{DIcon|Reward}} Hsin's Fortuity ::'''Xianchen:''' {{Rover}}, do you want to challenge today's Hsin's Fortuity? ::{{DIcon}} Play Hsin's Fortuity :::'''Xianchen:''' Waiting for results... ::;(Wanning Moon) ::::'''Xianchen:'''Oh, It's the waning moon. This is unfortunate, but I've also prepared some commemorative gifts. Here you go! ::;(Waxing Moon) ::::'''Xianchen:'''Oh, It's actually the waxing moon. {{Rover}}, congratulations on winning the grand prize. Here's your reward! :;(Talk to Xianchen again after playing Hsin's Fortuity) :::'''Xianchen:''' I'm really sorry, {{Rover}}, but you can only play Hsin's Fortuity once every day. :{{DIcon}} Chat ::'''Xianchen:''' My shoulders are so stiff... guess I don't have the same energy I once had. ::'''Xianchen:''' Most of the prizes are the latest designs from the Pioneer Association's production department. There's some all-new ones too, so they'll get some buzz. ::'''Xianchen:''' If someone wins a prize and spreads the word, it could be the next big thing! ::'''Xianchen:''' The Pioneer Association really needs a makeover.
